category: S3-compatible object storage (German host, Frankfurt EQ datacenter)

free_tier.stated: EUR 3.95 per TB, prepaid, up to 100 TB per account, 30 million objects per bucket

egress.terms: Verbatim: "Ingress ist kostenlos und unbegrenzt. Egress enthaelt 10 TB pro 1 TB Storage." — i.e. an included ratio of 10 TB egress per 1 TB booked storage, not truly unmetered. At 20 TB booked that is 200 TB/month included, which covers the client's 30 TB/month serving load with 6x headroom.

interface_detail: S3 API, IAM-enabled, multi-redundant in Frankfurt
tooling: Any S3 SDK / rclone / AWS CLI (vendor states full S3 compatibility)
chaining: Direct S3 origin; put Cloudflare in front to make even the included 200 TB/month irrelevant.
limits_note: `request-rate`/ratio cap: egress beyond the 10:1 allowance has no published price — unverified. Prepaid billing only. Endpoint not published on the page; s3.datalix.de does not resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN), so the endpoint must be taken from the customer panel.
reliability_note: Small single-datacenter German host (~TB-scale customer base). No public status page found; treat as single-region.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: "3,95 EUR pro TB", "Monatlicher Prepaid Preis 3,95 EUR", "Inklusiver Egress 10 TB", "Egress enthaelt 10 TB pro 1 TB Storage", "100 TB max. pro Account", "30 Mio. Objekte je Bucket", FAQ: "Preis: 3,95 EUR pro TB" / "Egress enthaelt 10 TB pro 1 TB Storage"
... — datalix.de surfaced as "S3-kompatibler Object Storage mieten ab 3,95EUR/TB", independent confirmation of the headline rate

price_per_tb_month: $4.44/TB at 5 TB (EUR 19.75 = $22.19) and $4.44/TB at 20 TB (EUR 79.00 = $88.75). Cheapest true S3 object storage in this survey.
